items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Gerald Hobson used to come and play with our band.

ctx.x: So there was a drummer, Gerald Hobson. Gerald Hobson used to come and play with our band. He lived in New York a long time and I used to like to listen to him telling me stories of New York.

And I was singing, too, so he told me, he said, "You know, Quentin," he said, "you got a good chance to make it in music." He said, "I'm going to Cincinnati and if I see anybody out there that wants a trombone player, I'll tell him about you because I think you got a good chance." So he went to Helvey's Troubadours in Cincinnati.
